summary: Explains how RSVP-TE signaling can link a restoration path to a failed one in GMPLS end-to-end recovery. It covers the case where the failed path is kept reserved rather than torn down, as well as resource sharing and reverting traffic to the original path. It reviews existing procedures and needs no new protocol extensions.

eli5.summary: If a road is closed, you take a detour but keep the old road saved for you until it reopens. This explains how the signs tell everyone about both roads.
